title: Native GPU Facade Critical-Path Attribution v1
scope: Diagnostic samples, not a new performance release. Per-node synchronous lane spans, not a whole-chain critical-path event trace. Inclusive/nested timings must not be added.

latency_us.definition: nearest-rank first native batch submission attempt to slowest of four final receipt replies; includes bounded one-query-per-session observer and submission-window scheduling
nearest-rank first native batch submission attempt to slowest of four final receipt replies; includes bounded one-query-per-session observer and submission-window scheduling

method.aggregation: Last checkpoint per resource address in native logs, final per resource in component logs; sum resource totals. Native active resources each end at a multiple of 64 exchanges. All exchanges have valid GPU timestamps.
method.device_interval: Whole timestamped command interval, including copy/dispatch/barriers; not shader-only. Per-dispatch interval also is not shader-only.
method.wait_interval: Host wait_for_submitted_fence wall span; includes device execution, queued work and CPU scheduling/wakeup. Does not distinguish these individually.
method.read_interval: read_u32_slice wall span including host result construction; not isolated PCIe transfer time.
method.shape: rows, input words per row, output buffer bytes; not output words.
method.formal_timing: Both node runs have stage profiling enabled. Off disables the extra facade counters and GPU timestamps, not all diagnostics. First submission through all-four final receipt replies is still timed; startup/signature generation excluded as before.
